desc: Derive the per-element reduction count \(d(x)=\lfloor\log_4 x\rfloor+1\).
Prove that the minimum number of pair operations is \(\lceil\text{total reductions}/2\rceil\), including odd total work and pairing with zero elements.
Implement a prefix function that sums \(d(x)\) over \([1,n]\) using powers-of-four intervals.
Compute each query’s total reduction count by prefix subtraction and add its ceiling-half operation count to the global answer.
Implement and verify the required `Solution.minOperations` Python format with efficient integer arithmetic.
